summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. completed a private offering of $230.0M aggregate principal of additional 1.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, priced at 110.25% of par plus accrued interest. The new notes are fungible with $375.0M initial notes issued April 2026 under the same indenture. Conversion rate is 9.9615 shares per $1,000, conversion price ~$100.39. Notes are senior unsecured, redeemable after April 2029 if stock exceeds 130% of conversion price. Offering used to raise capital; no change in control or acquisition. Watch for dilution risk and conversion triggers.
